verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only Trello's core board layout ('visual layout' and 'create a board'). Nothing documents switching the same work between board, list, calendar, and timeline views. 'Sync your calendar and allocate focused time slots' describes calendar syncing and time-blocking, not a calendar view of board cards. The Power-Ups line that some 'give you a new view into the data' is a developer extension point, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
